name: Selfie PullAI
description: A high-performance, privacy-focused, client-side image processing application for selfies that leverages on-device AI.

features.name: Create Project Structure & Entry Point
features.description: Initialize the project with the required file structure (index.html, css/style.css, js/app.js, js/modules/). Create the index.html file with the basic HTML5 boilerplate and link the CSS and JS files.
steps: Create index.html with valid HTML5 structure
Link css/style.css and js/app.js correctly
Ensure directory structure matches the constitution conventions
Verify index.html loads without console errors and styles are applied

features.name: Implement CSS Variables & Reset
features.description: Define CSS variables for colors, fonts, and spacing to ensure consistency. Implement a minimal CSS reset to normalize browser styles.
steps: Define CSS variables for primary colors, fonts, and spacing
Apply basic reset (box-sizing, margin/padding removal)
Establish mobile-first base styles
Verify variables are available and reset styles are applied in browser

features.name: Implement Responsive Layout Skeleton
features.description: Build the main layout using CSS Grid/Flexbox. Create placeholders for Header, Template Carousel, Upload Area, Editor Panel, and Action Buttons. Ensure responsiveness from 320px to 2560px.
steps: Create Header, Carousel, Upload, Editor, and Actions sections
Ensure layout adapts to mobile (stacked) and desktop (side-by-side or grid) views
Use semantic HTML tags (header, main, section, footer)
Verify layout integrity on 320px width

features.name: Define Template Data & Store Module
features.description: Create a hardcoded JSON array of celebrity templates. Implement the Store module to manage application state (current template, user image, history).
steps: Create js/modules/store.js
Implement state management logic (getters/setters/subscribers)
Make hardcoded template data available in the store
Verify initial state can be logged to console

features.name: Implement IndexedDB Wrapper
features.description: Create a utility module for IndexedDB to store generated images (history). This replaces LocalStorage to handle larger image data blobs.
steps: Create js/modules/db.js (or similar)
Implement functions for saveImage, getImages, deleteImage
Handle database initialization and upgrades
Verify saving and retrieving a dummy object from IndexedDB

features.name: Build Template Carousel with Lazy Loading
features.description: Render the template list into the UI. Implement a horizontal scroll or grid view. Use IntersectionObserver to lazy load template images.
steps: Render templates from Store data
Load images only when scrolled into view
Update Store state on selection
Verify network requests occur only when images are visible

features.name: Implement File Input & Drag-and-Drop
features.description: Implement handlers for file input selection and drag-and-drop events on the upload area. Validate file type and size (< 5MB).
steps: Highlight area when dragging a file over it
Read dropped file as a Data URL/Blob
Trigger error message for non-image or large files
Update Store state with valid image
Verify drag and drop works for valid images and rejects invalid ones

features.name: Implement Camera Capture
features.description: Add a 'Take Photo' button that opens the device camera using navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia. Capture a frame and pass it to the Store as the user image.
steps: Open camera stream in a video element
Freeze frame and convert to image on 'Capture' button click
Stop camera stream after capture
Handle fallback/errors for devices without camera or permission denied
Verify successful capture on a device with camera

features.name: Initialize Canvas & Basic Drawing
features.description: Set up the HTML5 Canvas element. Implement the rendering loop to draw the selected template (background) and the user's uploaded image (foreground).
steps: Create js/modules/canvas.js
Resize canvas correctly to fit container/aspect ratio
Draw template image on canvas
Draw user image on top of template
Verify both images appear on the canvas

features.name: Integrate Gemini Nano Banana Image API
features.description: Integrate the 'Gemini Nano Banana Image API' for image processing. If the API is for segmentation/background removal, apply it to the user image. If unavailable, implement a mock/fallback pass-through.
steps: Initialize API client (if applicable)
Process user image through API before rendering
Implement fallback mechanism if API fails or is not present
Verify API interaction or fallback behavior

features.name: Implement Canvas Interaction (Drag/Move)
features.description: Add event listeners (mouse and touch) to the canvas to allow dragging the user image. Update the position coordinates in the Store/State.
steps: Make user image follow mouse/finger drag
Ensure movement is smooth (60fps)
Update position state correctly
Verify smooth movement with mouse and touch

features.name: Implement Transformation Controls (Scale, Rotate, Opacity)
features.description: Create UI sliders for Scale, Rotation, and Opacity. Bind these inputs to update the rendering parameters.
steps: Update visual state of user image on canvas via sliders
Implement scale range: 50% - 200%
Implement rotation range: 0 - 360 degrees
Implement opacity range: 0 - 100%
Verify immediate visual feedback on canvas when adjusting sliders

features.name: Optimize Rendering Loop
features.description: Ensure the canvas rendering uses requestAnimationFrame. Debounce slider inputs if necessary to prevent excessive state updates.
steps: Decouple rendering logic from input events via requestAnimationFrame
Ensure no visual lag during rapid slider movement
Verify frame rate during interaction using DevTools

features.name: Implement Image Export
features.description: Add functionality to the 'Download' button. Convert the canvas content to a Blob/Data URL and trigger a browser download.
steps: Save image as PNG/JPG on Download click
Include timestamp or template name in filename
Verify saved file opens and looks correct

features.name: Implement Share Functionality
features.description: Use the Web Share API to share the generated image. Fallback to clipboard copy if Web Share is unsupported.
steps: Invoke native share sheet on mobile via 'Share' button
Copy image or show instructions on desktop as fallback
Verify native share sheet on mobile device

features.name: Connect History UI
features.description: When an image is downloaded/shared, save it to IndexedDB. Render the list of recent images in the History section.
steps: Save generated images to DB
Display thumbnails of recent images in History section
Re-load or allow download when clicking a history item
Verify images persist and appear in history after reload

features.name: Accessibility Audit & Fixes
features.description: Run accessibility checks. Ensure all interactive elements have aria-labels, focus states are visible, and contrast ratios are sufficient.
steps: Ensure keyboard navigation works for all controls
Verify screen readers announce buttons and sliders correctly
Achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
Verify announcements using a screen reader

features.name: Final Bundle Optimization
features.description: Review code for unused functions. Ensure assets are optimized. Verify total size is under 150KB (excluding external template images).
steps: Ensure main bundle is < 150KB
Clean and comment code
Verify transfer size of initial load
